coupling: The segment-merging commit reserves one byte and, for a split PFB private dictionary without a trailing newline, appends a decrypted PostScript newline and includes it in private_len. The later size-check commit independently reserves one byte and writes a NUL at private_dict[private_len]. Either edit alone stays within its one-byte reserve. Together the newline consumes that reserve, so the NUL write is one byte past the heap allocation. Repair requires accounting for both post-decryption bytes when allocating or changing the shared buffer contract across the two commits.
